hooks.name: Validate Source Structure
hooks.description: Validates that new source files have the required structure (fetcher.ts, parser.ts, parser.test.ts with fixtures) and prompts to create missing files

action.command:
bash -c '
# Read session context to get the file path
context=$(cat)
file_path=$(echo "$context" | jq -r ".filePath // \"\"")

# Only process if it'\''s in packages/core/src/sources
if [[ ! "$file_path" =~ ^packages/core/src/sources/ ]]; then
  exit 0
fi

# Extract source folder (e.g., packages/core/src/sources/npm -> npm)
source_dir=$(dirname "$file_path")

echo "📁 New file created in source directory: $source_dir"
echo ""

# Check for required files
missing=()

if [ ! -f "$source_dir/fetcher.ts" ]; then
  missing+=("fetcher.ts")
fi

if [ ! -f "$source_dir/parser.ts" ]; then
  missing+=("parser.ts")
fi

if [ ! -f "$source_dir/parser.test.ts" ]; then
  missing+=("parser.test.ts")
else
  # Check if parser.test.ts uses fixtures
  if ! grep -q "fixtures/" "$source_dir/parser.test.ts"; then
    echo "⚠️  parser.test.ts exists but doesn'\''t reference fixtures/"
    echo "   Tests should use recorded responses from fixtures/ instead of live network calls"
    echo ""
  fi
fi

if [ ${#missing[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "❌ Missing required files in $source_dir:"
  for file in "${missing[@]}"; do
    echo "   - $file"
  done
  echo ""
  echo "💡 Each source folder should have:"
  echo "   - fetcher.ts (makes the HTTP request)"
  echo "   - parser.ts (transforms the response)"
  echo "   - parser.test.ts (tests parser with fixture data)"
  echo ""
  echo "Would you like me to create the missing files?"
else
  echo "✅ All required files present in $source_dir"
fi
'
